faces.transcription: Scratch 1 cover from each alias in each passport.
faces.flavor: "Internal inquiry discovered your 'off-the-book' dealings with Sabik. It's a serious violation of CIA methodology, but...I understand. I know it seems absurd to dilly-dally in protocol when the world hangs in the balance, but there is a reason for all of it; not every agent is as trustworthy as you. I covered for you, but unfortunately not before the inquiry drew a great deal of attention to you."
